texts.english: Your first Spark Skiff already earns Radiance. Buy another from the harbor fleet when its price is affordable. Five producer kinds make Radiance; each successive purchase of a kind costs more.

texts.english: Buy 1 makes one purchase. Buy max spends what the fleet can currently afford. Forecasts assume the displayed fleet and conditions; a later purchase or an expiring bonus can change the result.

texts.english: At 25, 50, 75 and 100 of a producer, that entire tier doubles its output. At 25 Charts, cross-tier connections let early producers strengthen later ones. Compare the displayed price and added network output instead of assuming the newest kind is always best.

texts.english: Automatic buying unlocks at 10 Charts. Choose payback-based buying or a priority order. One saved plan slot is included; extra slots hold alternative plans and do not produce extra income by themselves. Automatic Rechart needs 100 Charts and your explicit Chart-gain and minimum-run settings.

texts.english: For one continuous absence, the first 24 hours of production earn at full rate. The next 48 hours earn at one quarter rate. Production stops after 72 hours away until you return. This limit is not restarted by a loading chunk or a second tap on the return summary.
texts.display: For one continuous absence, the first 24 hours of production earn at full rate. The next 48 hours earn at one quarter rate. Production stops after 72 hours away until you return. This limit is not restarted by a loading chunk or a second tap on the return summary.

texts.english: Returning settles your actual fleet, purchases and expiring effects over elapsed time. The return summary reports that settlement. Saving and recovery must finish before it is treated as committed progress.
texts.display: Returning settles your actual fleet, purchases and expiring effects over elapsed time. The return summary reports that settlement. Saving and recovery must finish before it is treated as committed progress.

texts.english: Focus stores one charge every 2 hours, up to 12. One charge supplies 10 minutes of a 20% production effect. Spending several charges adds time rather than multiplying the strength.
texts.display: Focus stores one charge every 2 hours, up to 12. One charge supplies 10 minutes of a 20% production effect. Spending several charges adds time rather than multiplying the strength.

texts.english: A Survey completes every 8 hours, up to 3 stored Surveys. Collecting each gives 10 Survey Notes. Full storage waits for you to collect or spend; it does not create a streak penalty.
texts.display: A Survey completes every 8 hours, up to 3 stored Surveys. Collecting each gives 10 Survey Notes. Full storage waits for you to collect or spend; it does not create a streak penalty.

texts.english: Three daily contract slots are retained for up to seven account days. Read each assigned goal and claim it when complete. An unclaimed slot can be rerolled once. Newly assigned goals do not count activity from before assignment.
texts.display: Three daily contract slots are retained for up to seven account days. Read each assigned goal and claim it when complete. An unclaimed slot can be rerolled once. Newly assigned goals do not count activity from before assignment.

texts.english: A seasonal alternative uses the same daily slot and claim receipt as its main-harbor goal. Completing both routes cannot grant the slot twice. Daily boundaries use the saved account-day offset. Changing time zone does not move that boundary, and turning the clock back does not replay an earlier day.
texts.display: A seasonal alternative uses the same daily slot and claim receipt as its main-harbor goal. Completing both routes cannot grant the slot twice. Daily boundaries use the saved account-day offset. Changing time zone does not move that boundary, and turning the clock back does not replay an earlier day.

texts.english: Free crew briefings and optional verified rewarded ads share six slots per account day. They give the same Support token. Refusing an ad, a failed ad or no available ad does not remove the free briefing route. Unspent daily tokens do not accumulate into a larger allowance tomorrow.
texts.display: Free crew briefings and optional verified rewarded ads share six slots per account day. They give the same Support token. Refusing an ad, a failed ad or no available ad does not remove the free briefing route. Unspent daily tokens do not accumulate into a larger allowance tomorrow.

texts.english: Spend a token once on a 20-minute, 25% production effect, or on an eligible offline Salvage cache. Salvage is capped by genuine recorded offline production and the displayed claim; it does not double your whole absence. The token and cache cannot be claimed twice.
texts.display: Spend a token once on a 20-minute, 25% production effect, or on an eligible offline Salvage cache. Salvage is capped by genuine recorded offline production and the displayed claim; it does not double your whole absence. The token and cache cannot be claimed twice.

texts.english: Local reminders start off. Enable them only if you want them, choose quiet hours and the reminder kinds, and turn them off at any time. Opening a reminder grants nothing. Device delivery can be delayed or denied without affecting play.
texts.display: Local reminders start off. Enable them only if you want them, choose quiet hours and the reminder kinds, and turn them off at any time. Opening a reminder grants nothing. Device delivery can be delayed or denied without affecting play.
